messages:
Jordan: Hey people-ops — I put in my two-week notice today (last day 2026-05-10). Quick Qs on COBRA and final paycheck timing: will COBRA premium be prorated for the last partial month? Also need to coordinate on-call handoff and laptop return. Thanks.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks Jordan — congrats on your next step. We're kicking off the offboard checklist. COBRA: coverage end is the last day of the month; COBRA election window email will go out within 14 days of termination. Premiums are not prorated mid-month; COBRA enrollment is billed from the 1st of the next month. If you need exact employer contribution numbers I can pull them.
Priya (Payroll): Hi Jordan — final paycheck is processed on the next regular payroll cycle after your termination date. For salaried staff that's typically within 7 business days. PTO payout: we include accrued eligible PTO if you confirm your balance.
Jordan: My PTO balance is ~24 hours (as of yesterday). Confirm that gets paid out and whether taxable withholding changes for final check?
Priya (Payroll): Confirmed — PTO payout will be included in the final pay. Withholding follows your last submitted W-4; if you need a different setup let us know ASAP.
Sam (IT): Sam here — on the IT side we'll schedule deprovision on your last working day at 5:00pm PT unless you prefer earlier. Please DM me a short list of service accounts/repos you still have access to and I'll revoke personal keys and rotate shared credentials.
Lina (Manager): Jordan please add the on-call runbook + escalation contacts to the handoff doc. I'll cover primary on-call for the first week after your exit and will update rotations with Priya.
Ava (People Ops): Jordan — we'll schedule an exit interview next week (private calendar invite). I'll send the COBRA notice + benefits FAQ to your personal email too. @Sam can you add 'keycard' to the deprovision checklist so facilities knows to disable access at 5pm on 2026-05-10? @Priya please confirm PTO payout inclusion.
Priya (Payroll): Confirmed — PTO payout included. If your bank info has changed please DM payroll@ to update before payroll cutoff.
Jordan: Bank on file is fine. I've added the runbook, pager notes, and a short playbook for the services I'm owning to the handoff doc.
Sam (IT): Got the docs. I've scheduled deprovision for 2026-05-10 17:00 PT. Will DM about repo permissions and any multi-factor devices that need transfer.
Ava (People Ops): Summary checklist: 1) Exit interview invite sent; 2) COBRA packet scheduled; 3) Final pay + PTO payout confirmed; 4) IT deprovision and keycard cutoff scheduled; 5) Laptop return label + shipping instructions inbound. If you need employment verification letter or PTO breakdown for future employers, reply here and we'll generate it. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick responses. I'll watch for the emails and DM Sam the repo list. :wave:
